title: LTO services now available at Cebu City’s 24/7 gov’t hub

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has started providing after-hours assistance for driver’s license renewals and vehicle registrations at the 24/7 Government Services Hub. This gives night-shift workers an alternative to completing the initial application process during regular office hours. Vice Mayor Tomas Osmeña announced on Tuesday, Sept. 22, that LTO personnel would begin serving at the Cebu Exchange Tower in Lahug from 9 p.m. to 6 a.m. daily. The arrangement initially covers assistance with license renewals, vehicle registration, and motorcycle plate distribution.
